alt: Real ChatGPT /languagedrill execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /languagedrill Using only the attached chapter, build an interactive three-item English terminology drill on training, inference and context. Include answer fields, checking, hints and explanations. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Enter inference for the first definition to demonstrate a terminology error.
Enter inference for the fixed-parameter calculation definition.
Enter context for the information available during inference.
Check all three terms and inspect correct and incorrect feedback.
Open the hint for the incorrectly named process.
Open the explanation distinguishing training from inference.
Replace the first term with training.
Check the revised answers and inspect the successful feedback.
Reset the exercise to practise the terms again.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
